name: KP1 (Klotho-derived peptide 1)
description: 30-amino-acid peptide cut from the human klotho protein (positions 57 to 86)

items.label: Erections
items.detail: Rats; peptide may not be KP1

note.text: Almost all KP1 studies come from one kidney research group in Guangzhou, China. No human study is published or registered.

bullets: **Bound the TGF-β type 2 receptor** and blocked TGF-β in kidney cells (lab)
**Restored kidney klotho** in mice; gathered mainly in injured kidneys
**Binds ATAD3A,** a mitochondrial protein, in kidney cells (2026, lab)
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Mouse, rat and cell studies since 2022

regulatory.text: Not approved; not on compounding lists
Not named; S0 bans unapproved substances

references: Nature Communications, klotho-derived peptide KP1 and kidney fibrosis, Jan 2022
Advanced Science, KP1 in acute kidney injury, Aug 2026
